svg.title: K8 sealed tub with magnetic pucks - overview
svg.desc: Front and top view of the K8 tub with an animated sequence: dosing, cutting, stirring, oven, jet gate and self-wash.
svg.text: FRONT VIEW (through the drive wall, from the room)
TOP VIEW (room / door at the bottom)
door cassette 115: skin, heads, gantry, décor panel
both views to the same scale
How force gets into a tub with no hole
• One Ø 150 ring of 20 magnets behind the 1.5 mm skin holds, drags and turns each puck:
110 N moving / 250 N holding, 12 Nm on the rotor (calculated, design values).
• More force is made from torque inside the ware: a screw cassette gives 2.5 kN from 12 Nm.
• Utensils may lean on the wall or stand on the floor (compression is unlimited).
• Turntable T (25 Nm) and spindle S (6000 rpm) drive through welded thimbles: no seal.
• After the meal the pucks carry each item through the jet gate, then the tub washes itself.
Red/blue dots = alternating magnet poles on the rotor; dashed orange = dry side. Time compressed;
real: full wash 25 min (ware dry), 26 L, 1.5 kWh; each vessel 20 s wash + 6 s rinse in the gate.
K8 — Sealed tub with magnetic pucks
A dishwasher-like stainless tub with no hole and no seal: passive pucks inside cling to
the door skin and follow magnet heads behind it; afterwards the tub washes itself.
1/8 The dock tilts the box: carrots fall through the ceiling port onto the board on turntable T
2/8 Puck 1 takes the chop knife from the top strip (bayonet) and slices: Z strokes, X steps
3/8 T turns the board 90° for the cross cuts; the squeegee pushes the dice into the pot on hob 1
4/8 Puck 2 stirs with the full-width paddle: sweeps in X, a short roll of the rotor folds the heap
5/8 The hook rod (rotor turned 90°) slides the braiser over the flush floor into the oven
6/8 Puck 1 carries the soiled board through the jet gate at X = 60 and rolls it through 360°
7/8 Pucks hang on pegs, heads retract 16 mm and leave; spray balls wash walls, floor and drive wall
8/8 Dry by stored heat and fan; heads return, the 20-pole rings snap back onto the pucks

g.text: spray balls: walls, floor, hob, drive wall
dry: stored heat of 40 kg steel + fan
